block.galacticraftcore.beam_receiver.des: Beam Receivers are connected to energy machine input and output, to transfer energy using beams.
block.galacticraftcore.beam_reflector.de: Beam Reflectors are used to redirect energy beams from source to destination. Can be right-clicked to cycle through targets.
block.galacticraftcore.cargo_loader.desc: Cargo Loaders will pass blocks and items onto Rockets and other vehicles with cargo space. Must be attached to Landing/Fueling pad.
block.galacticraftcore.cargo_unloader.de: Cargo Unloaders will extract blocks and items from Rockets and other vehicles with cargo space. Must be attached to Landing/Fueling pad.
block.galacticraftcore.cavernous_vines.d: Cavernous Vines are dangerous to living creatures, entangling them and dragging them upwards.
block.galacticraftcore.creeper_egg.desc: Creeper Eggs will spawn in Mars dungeons, spawning a sneaky predator upon exploding.
block.galacticraftcore.cryogenic_chamber: Cryogenic Chambers will allow a player to sleep during the day, healing a small amount of health, but has a cooldown.
block.galacticraftcore.electrolyzer.desc: Transforms water into hydrogen (useful for the Methane Synthesizer) and oxygen.
block.galacticraftcore.gas_liquefier.des: Liquefies gases, either from the atmosphere or from canisters. Liquefied methane makes a good rocket fuel!
block.galacticraftcore.launch_controller: Launch Controllers are used to customize launch behavior, including launch criteria and destination launch pad for auto launches.
block.galacticraftcore.methane_synthesiz: With a source of hydrogen and a source of carbon, this manufactures Methane for further processing in a Gas Liquefier.
block.galacticraftcore.miner_base.desc: The Astro Miner Base is the docking point for an Astro Miner.  It's big ... try making a 2 x 2 x 2 cube with these.
block.galacticraftcore.short_range_telep: Short Range Telepads are used to transfer players and other living creatures short distances (250 Blocks) when linked to other telepads.
block.galacticraftcore.slimeling_egg.des: Slimeling Eggs, once cracked with a player's bare hands, will soon hatch into a pet.
block.galacticraftcore.spin_thruster.des: Spin Thrusters are used to make space stations rotate.
block.galacticraftcore.terraformer.desc: Terraformers are used to add some greenery to distant planets, adding grass, trees and water when given the correct materials.
block.galacticraftcore.treasure_chest_ti: Tier 1 Treasure Chests will generate in Moon Dungeons. They are unlockable after defeating the final boss.
Tier 2 Treasure Chests will generate in Mars Dungeons. They are unlockable after defeating the final boss.
block.galacticraftcore.walkway.desc: Walkways are used for decorative purposes, used for connecting blocks while maintaining a space theme.
block.galacticraftcore.walkway_pipe.desc: Fluid Pipe Walkways are used for running pipes underneath a fully walkable surface.
block.galacticraftcore.walkway_wire.desc: Aluminum Wire Walkways are used for running wire underneath a fully walkable surface.
